Name: Adventurer's Handbook
Author: laceihaim
Description:
📚 Adventurer’s Handbook

Keep track of your [b]Monster Slayer goals[/b] with a clean, live HUD overlay
- Shows your current kill counts for Adventurer’s Guild quests
- Updates live whenever you defeat a monster
- Displays localized quest names for better immersion
- Hides progress until you complete the [i]Initiation[/i] quest and join the guild

[line]
📥 [b]How to Install
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b] (the Stardew Valley mod loader).
[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [i]Adventurer’s Handbook[/i].
[/*]
[*]Place the entire mod folder inside your game’s Mods folder.
[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI — your kill counts will appear automatically once you’re in the guild!
[/*]
[/list][line]
⚙️ [b]Configuration[/b]
[list]
[*]After the first launch, a config.json file will be generated where you can customize the HUD text color and size. [/*]
[*]You can also move the HUD frame by pressing [b]F8[/b], then press [b]F8[/b] again to save its position. The hotkey for this action can also be changed in the config.json file.[/*]
[/list]
